name: ACG
tagline: Predicts which files each coding task will touch so parallel agents can work without colliding.
problem: Parallel agents fight over files, pay for too much context and break merges.
solution: Static graph analysis of routes, imports and symbols predicts each task's write-set, plans tasks as a DAG and writes a lock file agents follow, served by a local MCP server.
demo_moment: Team-described benchmark: prompt tokens down from 3,721 to 1,700 and 7 of 7 tasks completed across up to five parallel agents.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Reports measured token and completion results.

lessons: A small benchmark with real numbers carries an infrastructure pitch.
